basic_info.description: Nestled on tree-lined Lexington Streeta charming one-way lane tucked between the vibrant Valencia and Mission Street corridorsthis spacious 2-bedroom plus den and office nook, 2-bath condo offers the perfect balance of residential calm and urban convenience. The glorious great room that every modern buyer wants features a wall of west-facing windows, and a gas fireplace. The spacious den boasts a sliding glass door that opens to a private, south-facing patio. With 1,390 sq.ft. of living space, the home also includes in-unit laundry, garage parking, deeded storage, a shared backyard, and storage galore. Both bedrooms have walk-in closets, while fresh paint and new countertops provide a move-in-ready feel.    Residents of Lexington Street prize its excellent walkability, world-class transit, and eclectic mix of architecturefrom ornate Victorians to sleek modern buildsquintessential San Francisco. Daily errands don't require a car, restaurants and parks are just blocks away, and quick freeway access makes commuting simple. Known for its sunny microclimate and welcoming, vibrant atmosphere, the Mission District location embodies the best of city living.    99 Walk Score | 94 Transit Score | 98 Bike Score
